personality_one_liner: A vibrant, tactile construction-site puzzle game featuring chunky, deeply satisfying interactions, bold industrial contrast, and immediate visual feedback.

spacing.rule: Generous touch-safe padding with a landscape-first approach. Modals and HUD elements must clear safe areas and leave the center screen unobstructed.

do's: Use dark frosted glass for the Pause menu and Level Complete overlays to separate HUD from gameplay.
Apply subtle glass on HUD containers to maintain visibility of the 3D scene behind them.
dont's: Do not use glass for primary CTA buttons (Play, Retry, Next). They must be solid and chunky.

screens.name: Main Menu
screens.purpose: A bold entry point that establishes the construction-site theme and player progress.
screens.layout: Landscape full-screen. Left/Center: Huge 'WRECKWORKS' title in Fredoka, angled slightly with a drop shadow. Right side: A chunky 'WORLD 1: CONSTRUCTION SITE' card (brandSecondary / Warning Yellow) displaying progress '0/10 Levels'. Bottom Right: Oversized, pill-shaped 'PLAY' button in Safety Orange (brandPrimary).

screens.name: Level Selection
screens.purpose: Showcases 10 levels in a satisfying, tactile grid.
screens.layout: Landscape safe-area constrained. Top: Back button and 'Construction Site' header. Center: A 2-row by 5-column grid (or horizontal scroll if preferred) of chunky level tiles. Locked: Gray tile with padlock. Unlocked: Orange tile. Completed: Yellow tile with up to 3 stars. Tiles should feel raised with clear borders.

screens.name: Gameplay HUD
screens.purpose: Minimalist interface overlay for the 3D physics game.
screens.layout: Edge-anchored to keep the center screen clear for aiming. Top-Left: Pause icon (pill-shaped glass container). Top-Right: Score / Stars progress bar. Bottom-Left: 'Shots Left' indicated by visually stacked cannonballs or structural elements. Interactions (aiming) handled by the GL canvas.

screens.name: Level Complete Overlay
screens.purpose: Rewarding modal that blocks the game state, summarizing the player's success.
screens.layout: Centered large card (surfaceSecondary) over a full-screen dark glass overlay. Top of card: 3 oversized star slots (animated fill). Middle: Score breakdown (Objects Destroyed, Shots Used, Best Score) aligned clearly. Bottom: Split chunky buttons - 'RETRY' (brandTertiary) and 'NEXT LEVEL' (brandPrimary).

instructions_to_main_agent: Enforce 'landscape' orientation in app configuration (app.json) and styling. No portrait layouts.
Implement chunky UI elements by stacking shadows or using bottom border widths (e.g., borderBottomWidth: 4, borderColor: '#CC4800' on the orange button) to mimic a 3D tactile button feel.

For the Level Select screen, use an oversized 2x5 grid or horizontal scrolling view. Clearly differentiate the 3 states: Locked (grayed out, icon), Current (pulsing/highlighted), Completed (shows 1-3 stars).
HUD must be safe-area aware. Use glass (`expo-blur`) for the HUD containers to ensure the game world remains partially visible beneath UI.
Use 'Fredoka' font for all headings, scores, and button text to emphasize the casual, playful aesthetic.
Level Complete overlay needs a dark scrim (glass + color tint at 85% opacity) covering the entire screen to block background interactions completely.
The warning stripe motif (yellow and black/dark gray diagonal lines) can be implemented via SVGs or Skia on headers/loading states to sell the Construction Site theme.
Do NOT use Angry Birds assets. Create original geometric UI shapes.
Ensure all interactive elements meet the minimum 44pt tap target requirement.
